newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 interested by U.K. move to long-term policy.
newsitem.headline: G10 interested by U.K. move to long-term policy.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said G10 central bank governors found it interesting that Britain's new Labour government had given the Bank of England power to set interest rates.
He said Bank of England Governor Eddie George had detailed for the group the changes that Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown had made.

"The chancellor has elaborated clearly that the interest is to break with the short-term orientation and to move to a longer-term orientation of monetary policy," Tietmeyer told reporters after the G10 governors' monthly meeting.
"This is in my view and the view of the (G10) colleagues a very interesting argument because it comes from the United kingdom," he added. He did not elaborate.
